paper.title_en: Two parameter regular core black holes: Geodesic, thermodynamic, scalar field spectral, and greybody diagnostics
paper.abstract_en: We study a phenomenological two parameter regular core black hole geometry in which the core scale and the radial transition profile are independently variable. Closed central limits of the Ricci scalar, Ricci contraction, and Kretschmann scalar establish curvature regularity. The reconstructed anisotropic source is analyzed through the null, weak, dominant, and strong energy conditions, together with radial and tangential sound speed diagnostics. Photon sphere, shadow, innermost stable circular orbit, and direct regular black hole comparisons quantify the geodesic response. An exact differential of the ADM mass supplies generalized work terms and a homogeneous Smarr relation, while the surface gravity temperature retains its geometric role. Massive scalar perturbations are examined using a dimensionally consistent third order WKB treatment, independent time domain ringdown fits, and Schwarzschild limit and derivative convergence tests. For the massless benchmark, the WKB frequency differs from the fitted time domain fundamental mode by less than one percent. Greybody transmission is restricted to the propagating regime and is extended to truncated absorption cross sections and Hawking emission spectra. A fixed absolute core scan demonstrates that the transition parameter has effects not reducible to normalization by the extremal core scale. •Two parameters independently control core size and transition shape.•Closed curvature limits establish a finite de Sitter center.•Time domain fits independently validate damped scalar oscillations.•Fixed core scans isolate transition profile effects on strong gravity.•Wave transmission determines absorption and thermal emission spectra.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该论文研究了双参数规则核心黑洞的测地线、热力学、标量场谱和灰体因子，涵盖曲率正则性、能量条件、光子球、阴影、ISCO、ADM质量、Smarr关系、标量扰动、WKB方法、灰体透射和霍金辐射谱，内容全面且具有理论深度，对黑洞热力学和广义相对论基础均有贡献。
decision.title_zh: 双参数规则核心黑洞：测地线、热力学、标量场谱和灰体诊断
decision.abstract_zh: 我们研究了一种唯象的双参数规则核心黑洞几何，其中核心尺度和径向过渡轮廓可独立变化。Ricci标量、Ricci收缩和Kretschmann标量的封闭中心极限确立了曲率正则性。重建的各向异性源通过零、弱、主和强能量条件以及径向和切向声速诊断进行分析。光子球、阴影、最内层稳定圆轨道和直接规则黑洞比较量化了测地线响应。ADM质量的精确微分提供了广义功项和齐次Smarr关系，而表面重力温度保留其几何作用。使用维度一致的第三阶WKB处理、独立时域振铃拟合以及Schwarzschild极限和导数收敛测试来检查大质量标量扰动。对于无质量基准，WKB频率与拟合的时域基模相差不到百分之一。灰体透射被限制在传播区域，并扩展到截断吸收截面和霍金发射谱。固定的绝对核心扫描表明，过渡参数具有不能通过极值核心尺度归一化来简化的效应。•两个参数独立控制核心大小和过渡形状。•闭合曲率极限建立有限的德西特中心。•时域拟合独立验证阻尼标量振荡。•固定核心扫描隔离过渡轮廓对强引力的影响。•波透射决定吸收和热发射谱。
